mentions.description: An idea for signal analysis to drive a desired signal-driven action, centered on grouping, categorizing, and stratifying signals into useful buckets that drive actions. The author points out that blind source separation has drawbacks: it keeps guessing at sources and labeling them as brand new instead of retaining a memory of previously identified sources, unlike humans, who can distinguish pianos from drums and remember the distinction across songs.
mentions.problem: Blind source separation continuously guesses at sources and labels them as brand new instead of having a memory of previously identified sources.
mentions.author: gabinator
